shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surges past $85K, forms 'golden cross'. BTC hit an 8-month high, breaking a year-long downtrend with a bullish technical 'golden cross' pattern.
Spot Bitcoin ETF inflows remain strong. Significant institutional demand continues, with recent spot Bitcoin ETF inflows of over $433M driving market recovery.
Crypto markets resilient to Fed rate hike. Despite the Federal Reserve raising rates by 25bps, crypto assets largely shrugged off the news and rallied.
US crypto regulation sees mixed progress. The CLARITY Act failed in the Senate, but the CFTC is advancing its own market structure rulemaking.
